abstract: Maintains non-intrusive archaeological protocols and magnetometry verification schedules
system_message:
You are the Marine archaeology investigator (ARC), responsible for maintaining non-intrusive archaeological protocols and magnetometry verification schedules for deep-sea shipwreck search and survey plans.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Magnetic target screening（ANOM）
information_points.content:
ARC-ANOM-DAJ：Preliminary aeromagnetic survey logs register a ferrous anomaly detection density of 9 targets exceeding 5 nT within ten square nautical miles of the distress site for the Towed Synthetic Aperture Sonar Transect.
ARC-ANOM-W44：Preliminary aeromagnetic survey logs register a ferrous anomaly detection density of 15 targets exceeding 5 nT within ten square nautical miles of the distress site for the Autonomous AUV Bathymetric Grid.
ARC-ANOM-ICF：Preliminary aeromagnetic survey logs register a ferrous anomaly detection density of 4 targets exceeding 5 nT within ten square nautical miles of the distress site for the Deep-Tow Side-Scan and Magnetometry Array.

information_points.title: Maintains non-intrusive archaeological protocols and magnetometry verification schedules（HERIT）
information_points.content:
ARC-HERIT-OJJ：For the Deep-Tow Side-Scan and Magnetometry Array, the non-intrusive survey protocol is approved by the scientific ethics review board, and the magnetometry verification duration encompasses 60 h of targeted magnetic gradient confirmation passes.
ARC-HERIT-NL6：For the Towed Synthetic Aperture Sonar Transect, the non-intrusive survey protocol is not approved by the scientific ethics review board, while the magnetometry verification duration is set at 30 h of low-altitude inspection runs.
ARC-HERIT-HE0：For the Autonomous AUV Bathymetric Grid, the non-intrusive survey protocol is approved according to the scientific ethics review board, and the magnetometry verification duration is scheduled for 30 h across fine-grid magnetic gradient passes.
